name: Sabae no Ou
source:
Hunter OPS's rookie vampire hunter Ain and her master, vampire hunter Rizeru infiltrates a certain deserted village in South America. 

Code 593 is activated because it is believed that this settlement has become a nest for vampires. There is also an unmanned military shelter below the village, accesible only by an elevator... 

Armed with guns, swords, arcane powers and with your guidance; will they be able stop these vampires? Or will they join them in the end?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=376366]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
Hunter OPS的新人吸血鬼猎人艾因与师父莉泽尔潜入南美洲某座荒废村庄。

由于这处聚落被认为已经成为吸血鬼巢穴，593号指令正式启动。村庄地下还有一座无人军事掩体，只能乘电梯进入……

凭借枪械、刀剑、秘术，以及你的指引，她们能否阻止这些吸血鬼？还是最终会成为其中一员？

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=376366]Getchu[/url]]
